data.one_liner: Step-by-step product tours and feature discovery with auto-positioned tooltips.
data.what_it_does: Highlights specific widgets on screen with an overlay and shows a step-by-step tooltip walkthrough. Drives tours using a small controller API and supports custom shapes, step transitions, and lifecycle callbacks.
use_when: You need to build an onboarding tour for first-time users.
You want to highlight specific UI elements with tooltips and dim the background.
avoid_when: You need complex state management libraries.
You are building static UI documentation without interactive walkthroughs.
strengths: No boilerplate or external state management needed
Supports custom tooltips, exact shapes, and animated transitions
Comprehensive lifecycle callbacks and programmatic control
weaknesses: Requires GlobalKeys for every target widget in the tour
Auto-scrolling requires targets to be rendered and laid out
data.setup_notes: Wrap the screen in a ShowCaseWidget and target widgets in Showcase with GlobalKeys.
